english.note: Use this when someone commits or promises to do something.

exampleSentences.english: I undertake to help him move house.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 jing3 zo2 bong1 keoi5 bun1 uk1

english.note: Choose this when agreeing to do something or consenting to a request.

exampleSentences.english: I agree to look after your son tonight.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我答應你今晚幫你睇住個仔。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 jing3 nei5 gam1 maan5 bong1 nei5 tai2 zyu6 go3 zai2

english.note: Use it when accepting means agreeing to a request, proposal, condition, or arrangement.

exampleSentences.english: If you accept my request this time, don't go back on your word.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次你答應我，就唔好再反口。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nei5 daap3 jing3 ngo5 zau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan2 hau2

english.note: Use this when granting means agreeing to a request or wish.

exampleSentences.english: They finally agreed to grant my request and accompany me to the doctor.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢終於答應我個要求，陪我去睇醫生。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 daap3 jing3 ngo5 go3 jiu1 kau4 pui4 ngo5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1
